_comment: Custom experimental Deadworks egg. Source and scripts reviewed; not live game-tested. No custom image build required.
name: Deadworks (Deadlock) - Wine - Experimental r2
author: local@example.com
description: Deadworks Windows dedicated server under Wine 11. AMD64 only. First start uses Steam mobile QR authentication, then downloads ~35 GB. Requires an account with Deadlock access. Allocate at least 60 GB disk. Custom integration, not live-tested. Source revision: 495553c90049449cb2b1090dba8d0c82506edac1

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip python3
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p .runtime/{depotdownloader,dotnet-win,deadworks} steam/home data plugins configs maps
fetch() { curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1" -o "$2"; }
fetch 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Deadworks-net/deadworks/495553c90049449cb2b1090dba8d0c82506edac1/docker/entrypoint.sh' '.runtime/entrypoint.sh'
echo 'dd30409ef479929ce1de9134074d2e151c2a7548f3523263ed5f61daacf6f584  .runtime/entrypoint.sh' | sha256sum --check -
fetch 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Deadworks-net/deadworks/495553c90049449cb2b1090dba8d0c82506edac1/docker/console.pl' '.runtime/console.pl'
echo '372d50b397325ad09b355aed970a07016d3b4ec5ed7dc639b57e743456d0e4b4  .runtime/console.pl' | sha256sum --check -
python3 - <<'PATCH_UPSTREAM'
import re
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.runtime')
mapping = {
    '/opt/depotdownloader': '/home/container/.runtime/depotdownloader',
    '/opt/deadworks': '/home/container/.runtime/deadworks',
    '/steam': '/home/container/steam',
    '/data': '/home/container/data',
    '/plugins': '/home/container/plugins',
    '/configs': '/home/container/configs',
    '/maps': '/home/container/maps',
}
# Match absolute paths only, not suffixes like managed/plugins or citadel/maps.
pattern = re.compile(r'(?<![\w/])(' + '|'.join(map(re.escape, mapping)) + r')(?=[/\s\"\x27;:]|$)')
for name in ('entrypoint.sh', 'console.pl'):
    text = (root / name).read_text()
    text = pattern.sub(lambda m: mapping[m.group()], text)
    if name == 'console.pl':
        # A readiness check must not pass merely because a download is in progress.
        text = text.replace("    exit 0 if -e '/tmp/deadworks-starting';", '')
    (root / name).write_text(text)
PATCH_UPSTREAM

fetch 'https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases/download/DepotDownloader_3.4.0/DepotDownloader-linux-x64.zip' .runtime/depotdownloader.zip
unzip -qo .runtime/depotdownloader.zip -d .runtime/depotdownloader
chmod +x .runtime/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader
fetch 'https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Runtime/10.0.12/dotnet-runtime-10.0.12-win-x64.zip' .runtime/dotnet.zip
unzip -qo .runtime/dotnet.zip -d .runtime/dotnet-win
fetch 'https://github.com/Deadworks-net/deadworks/releases/download/v0.4.18/deadworks-v0.4.18.zip' .runtime/deadworks.zip
unzip -qo .runtime/deadworks.zip -d .runtime/deadworks
echo v0.4.18 > .runtime/deadworks/.version
test -f .runtime/deadworks/game/bin/win64/deadworks.exe
test -d .runtime/dotnet-win/host/fxr
rm -f .runtime/depotdownloader.zip .runtime/dotnet.zip .runtime/deadworks.zip
cat > start-deadworks.sh <<'PELICAN_LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/container
export WINEPREFIX=/home/container/data/wineprefix
export WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all
# Override the generic image's mscoree disable: .NET assemblies need it enabled.
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mshtml,winemenubuilder.exe=d'
export DOTNET_ROOT='Z:\home\container\.runtime\dotnet-win'
export DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute=0
export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp
mkdir -p steam/game steam/home data/wineprefix plugins configs maps
for tool in wine wineboot wineserver perl curl unzip flock; do
    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "Missing runtime dependency: $tool"; exit 1; }
done
perl -MIO::Socket::INET -MIO::Select -e 1
[[ -x .runtime/depotdownloader/DepotDownloader ]] || {
    echo 'Installation incomplete. Reinstall this server from Pelican.'; exit 1;
}
[[ -n "${STEAM_USERNAME:-}" ]] || {
    echo 'Set Steam Username on the Startup page to an account with Deadlock access.'; exit 1;
}
if [[ "${LOGIN_MODE:-auto}" == login ]] || \
   [[ ! -f steam/.pelican-login ]] || \
   [[ "$(cat steam/.pelican-login 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$STEAM_USERNAME" ]]; then
    echo 'Steam login: scan the QR code below with the Steam mobile app.'
    echo 'The account must match Steam Username. Keep this console open.'
    bash .runtime/entrypoint.sh login
    printf '%s\n' "$STEAM_USERNAME" > steam/.pelican-login
fi

server_pid=''
input_pid=''
ready_pid=''
cleanup() {
    trap - TERM INT
    [[ -z "$input_pid" ]] || kill "$input_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -z "$ready_pid" ]] || kill "$ready_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    if [[ -n "$server_pid" ]]; then
        kill -TERM "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        wineserver -k 2>/dev/null || true
        wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}
trap 'cleanup; exit 0' TERM INT
exec 3<&0
bash .runtime/entrypoint.sh run </dev/null &
server_pid=$!
(
    while kill -0 "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
        if perl .runtime/console.pl --ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo 'PELICAN_DEADWORKS_READY'
            break
        fi
        sleep 5
    done
) &
ready_pid=$!
(
    while IFS= read -r line <&3; do
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        perl .runtime/console.pl "$line" || echo 'Console unavailable: the server may still be starting.'
    done
) &
input_pid=$!
result=0
wait "$server_pid" || result=$?
cleanup
exit "$result"
PELICAN_LAUNCHER
chmod +x start-deadworks.sh .runtime/entrypoint.sh .runtime/console.pl
echo 'Installed. Start the server and complete Steam authentication in the Console.'

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam login name, not display name. Account must own/access Deadlock. First start uses Steam mobile QR login; no password is stored in the egg.

variables.name: Steam Login Mode
variables.description: auto: authenticate if no cached login, then run. login: force fresh authentication before running; return to auto afterwards.

variables.name: Join Password
variables.description: Optional player join password. Avoid quotes and semicolons.

variables.name: Update Game on Start
variables.description: 1 checks for updates before launch. First download needs 1. The generic image SteamCMD updater is unused because SRCDS_APPID is unset.

variables.name: Deadworks Version
variables.description: Use latest, image, or a release tag such as v0.4.18. latest follows upstream releases. image uses the bundled v0.4.18 fallback. A game patch may require a newer Deadworks release.
